item.title: Anthropic May Land at 'Double B': The AI Books Get Their First Counterfeit Check
item.description: In its $63B chip financing, Blackstone told investors Anthropic will probably come out of the IPO in the 'double B' range (top of junk). Its own last forecast was investment-grade by 2027. I read the FT reporting via TechCrunch and Stoller's S-1 teardown. Three things stuck: ratings are just a counterfeit check on the AI books; the genuinely odd figure in the S-1 is how often third-party companies are mentioned; and the Amazon comparison is the most useful coordinate in the story.
